banter: Please keep your voice down. The dictionaries are trying to define silence.
We lend books, not alibis. The waiting list for those would be unbearable.
The crime section is over there. The true-crime section is being questioned by the police.
If you find a suspicious bookmark, please leave it in the suspicious book.
They asked whether overdue books could be extradited. I finally felt understood.
I remember every visitor who damages a book. It is less a memory than a prosecution file.
No running, no shouting, and absolutely no underlining in the rare editions.
repeatLines: At least somebody is renewing their interest.
You asked about a suspect rather than the toilets.
falseLeadLines: Nobody matching that description has asked me anything useful.
You may be following the wrong chapter.
Your suspect is not in this edition.

books: @editable:They were researching their next stop. Their reading slip described {literaryBook}. They wanted to use literature as a map. I recommended an actual map.
@editable:For their next destination, they copied a reference to {literaryBook}. Then they folded the page. That is when I became a witness.
@editable:They left a note about their next stop: {literaryBook}. The book was returned. My faith in humanity was not.
@editable:Their next destination was being researched through {literaryBook}. They asked whether the ending would spoil the journey. I said only if the police arrived first.
